compatibility.breaking_change_policy: Field removals, required-field additions, type changes, and semantic renames require a new schema id. New optional fields are backward-compatible.
compatibility.output_contract: Existing CLI --json output is not changed by this contract export.
compatibility.secrets_policy: Contracts, examples, tests, logs, and errors must not include passwords, OAuth tokens, app passwords, or raw OTP values unless the command purpose is OTP retrieval.
